name: inheritance9.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (a Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (a Int)(b Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (a Int)(b Int)(c Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D (mk-D (a Int)(b Int)(c Int)(d Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((E (mk-E (a Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  (lift-D (sel-D D))
  (lift-E (sel-E E))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D ((this Ref)) D
  (sel-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-E ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-E (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-E ((this Ref)) E
  (sel-E (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-D this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-E ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-E this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.a: ---

(define-fun A!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.a: ---

(define-fun B!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.b: ---

(define-fun B!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-B this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class C:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for C.a: ---

(define-fun C!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.b: ---

(define-fun C!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.c: ---

(define-fun C!c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-C this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class D:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for D.a: ---

(define-fun D!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-D this))
)

; --- getters for D.b: ---

(define-fun D!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-D this))
)

; --- getters for D.c: ---

(define-fun D!c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-D this))
)

; --- getters for D.d: ---

(define-fun D!d ((this Ref)) Int
  (d (deref-D this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class E:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for E.a: ---

(define-fun E!a ((this Ref)) Ref
  (a (deref-E this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-A A)
(declare-const const-3-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!a this) 10)
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 2) :named _xkassert0))
(assert (! (A.inv1 3) :named _xkassert1))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!a this) 10)
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 4) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!b this) (+ (B!a this) 1))
)

(assert (! (B.inv2 4) :named _xkassert3))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-C C)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun C.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!a this) 10)
)

(assert (! (C.inv1 5) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun C.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!b this) (+ (C!a this) 1))
)

(assert (! (C.inv2 5) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun C.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!c this) (+ (C!b this) 1))
)

(assert (! (C.inv3 5) :named _xkassert6))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class D:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-6-D D)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun D.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!a this) 10)
)

(assert (! (D.inv1 6) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun D.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!b this) (+ (D!a this) 1))
)

(assert (! (D.inv2 6) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun D.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!c this) (+ (D!b this) 1))
)

(assert (! (D.inv3 6) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun D.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!d this) (+ (D!c this) 1))
)

(assert (! (D.inv4 6) :named _xkassert10))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class E:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-E E)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun E.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-A (E!a this))
)

(assert (! (E.inv1 1) :named _xkassert11))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        2 (lift-A const-2-A))
        3 (lift-A const-3-A))
        4 (lift-B const-4-B))
        5 (lift-C const-5-C))
        6 (lift-D const-6-D))
        1 (lift-E const-1-E))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-D (select heap 6))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-B (select heap 4))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (a (sel-B (select heap 4))) 1)))
  (= (b (sel-B (select heap 4))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (a (sel-C (select heap 5))) 1)))
  (= (b (sel-C (select heap 5))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (b (sel-D (select heap 6))) 1)))
  (= (c (sel-D (select heap 6))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a (sel-E (select heap 1))))))
  (or (is-lift-A a!1) (is-lift-B a!1) (is-lift-C a!1) (is-lift-D a!1))))
(define-fun const-1-E () E
  (mk-E 3))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-A (select heap 2))) 10))
(define-fun const-6-D () D
  (mk-D 10 11 12 13))
(define-fun const-2-A () A
  (mk-A 10))
(define-fun const-5-C () C
  (mk-C 10 11 12))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (b (sel-C (select heap 5))) 1)))
  (= (c (sel-C (select heap 5))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (a (sel-D (select heap 6))) 1)))
  (= (b (sel-D (select heap 6))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-A (select heap 3))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (c (sel-D (select heap 6))) 1)))
  (= (d (sel-D (select heap 6))) a!1)))
(define-fun const-4-B () B
  (mk-B 10 11))
(define-fun const-3-A () A
  (mk-A 10))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-C (select heap 5))) 10))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null) 2 (lift-A (mk-A 10)))
                  3
                  (lift-A (mk-A 10)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 4 (lift-B (mk-B 10 11)))
                  5
                  (lift-C (mk-C 10 11 12)))))
  (store (store a!2 6 (lift-D (mk-D 10 11 12 13))) 1 (lift-E (mk-E 3))))))
